items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Did you remember any occasions on which say like Coleman Hawkins, Roy Eldridge, Louis Armstrong sat in with the band? [INTERVIEWEE] With our band? No. No. Hawk never played with our band.

ctx.x: Hawk, Ben Webster and those guys, they're once in a lifetime. You know.
Oh, I know what I wanted to ask you. Did you remember any occasions on which say like Coleman Hawkins, Roy Eldridge, Louis Armstrong sat in with the band?

With our band? No. No. Hawk never played with our band. Louis -- Pops -- did Pops ever play with our band? He may have. He may have accompanied on something special, an occasion. Because him and Duke and all us were close, dear friends. But I mean actually -- you mean sit in? No.
